_how: One entry per operating system: a clean checkout (fresh clone, no .env, no workspace) taken through setup, build, selftest and quickstart exactly as README and How to Use This Book say. release_manifest.py keeps a gate open for each system missing here.

Windows.environment: Windows 11 Home 10.0.26200, Docker Desktop (engine 29.8.1, WSL 2), launched with .\course.cmd (Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100)
Windows.notes: check --api and local up --gpu weren't repeated in the clean clone because the main checkout's local model already held port 11434; both run in the main checkout on the same machine (RTX 4060, every local-model rerun on 2026-10-15). Found and fixed: quickstart printed ./course.sh commands on Windows; it now prints .\course.cmd.
